description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Quartz Eye Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Synchro Mode] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Fire, Ice, Lightning Ability +15% Boost 1] and [Dualcast Witch 1]/[Fire, Ice, Lightning Ability +30% Boost 1] and [Dualcast Witch 1]/[Fire, Ice, Lightning Ability +30% Boost 3] and [Dualcast Witch 3] to the user if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF1 allies are alive

description.name: Quartz Eye Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Fire, Ice, Lightning Ability +15% Boost 1
description.text: Fire, Ice or Lightning abilities deal 15% more damage

description.name: Fire, Ice, Lightning Ability +30% Boost 1
description.text: Fire, Ice or Lightning abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Fire, Ice, Lightning Ability +30% Boost 3
description.text: Fire, Ice or Lightning abilities deal 30% more damage
